title: The Spacetime–Electromagnetic Framework: Mathematical Structures and Obstructions in Split-Signature Clifford Geometry
description:
Version 1.0.0 — Preprint, not peer reviewed.

A study of the real Clifford algebra Cl(3,3) of the split space R3,3 — three temporal directions paired with three spatial ones — and of its graded tower Cl(3n,3n): which ingredients of relativistic field theory the algebra fixes, which it merely admits, and which it obstructs. The manuscript states every selection beyond the algebra (clock, projector, potential, couplings, gauge principle) as an assumption, proves the obstructions it finds, and is accompanied by a chapter-organized verification package of 61 scripts with 1389 exact or numerical checks. It is a mathematical research manuscript, not a completed unified physical theory: no gravitational dynamics is derived and no experimental confirmation is claimed.
